body: Lumines II is Q Entertainment's PSP puzzle game, first released in North America on 7 November 2006. Falling blocks contain four squares whose colours must be arranged into larger matching groups. A Time Line sweeps across the board, clearing completed groups in time with the music. The sequel expands the original's collection of visual and musical skins, including licensed recordings and videos. A familiar arrangement problem therefore changes its atmosphere as the session continues, with the sound and moving line giving the player another rhythm through which to read the board.

A matching square does not disappear as soon as it is formed. It remains until the Time Line reaches it, allowing further blocks to enlarge the cleared area before that moment arrives. This delay creates the game's particular tension: the player is preparing a future result while new pieces continue to demand space. Clearing several groups together raises the reward, but a crowded board leaves fewer safe placements. Music helps make the line's movement predictable, turning timing into part of a puzzle whose individual blocks can be understood at a glance.

Mission mode offers specific challenges, Skin Edit changes the sequence of presentation and the Sequencer provides another musical activity beside the main puzzle. Tetsuya Mizuguchi wanted the sequel to feel like a different party, broadening the soundtrack with artists such as New Order, Missy Elliott and Beck. Reviewers welcomed the added features while differing over the licensed song selection. Katsumi Yokota and Takayuki Nakamura contributed music and design. Lumines II develops a simple relationship rather than replacing it: the blocks supply the problem, and the music helps determine when its solution becomes visible.
